## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 85 captures during June 2025. This represents the activity submitted for review during the reporting month. The volume provides the basis for assessing image quality and grading outcomes at the site. Staff should continue to ensure that completed captures are submitted through the usual process and that any operational issues affecting activity are recorded promptly.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 5 were marked ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 5.9. The site should review the circumstances associated with ungradable images and reinforce the required image-capture process where appropriate. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate support arrangements.

## Grading

Grading identified 16 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This measure should continue to be monitored alongside activity and image quality to support timely review. The results provide a basis for local follow-up and ongoing discussion with the service supporting the site’s camera and grading processes.
